summary: The build stamp's git status no longer writes the refreshed index back (git --no-optional-locks status). On a fresh or restored checkout that write changed one of the stamp script's own inputs, so the next local cargo command reran it and rebuilt the fractal package and everything depending on the stamp although nothing had changed. The stamp's value is unchanged.

replay.detail: Build tooling only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change; the baked build identity is the same.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.
